title: App crashing
text: App is crashing after the update, I skip the page asking me to pay for a subscription and then it crashes right after every time so it’s currently not operational

title: Great app just annoying to open
text: It’s an amazing app and I have been using it to organize my inventory…but opening the app is extremely inconvenient especially when in a rush. It offers a payment plan for a “deluxe” version of the app every time you open it. Even if it’s a minute in between. I wish there was a “do not show again” option

title: Unable to add a secondary user
text: Im very disappointed that i was billed 24 dlls and im getting a message of “internal error” when I try to send the invitation to my son. It speaks volumes when im running into glitches 1 min after downloading the app.

title: Privacy?
text: Refers back to google about security. Data sharing seems limited but I am not sure

title: Look Elsewhere.  This ain’t it.
text: I saw someone demo this on tictok and gave it a try. Spent money on a stack of labels and went to work on the 12 storage bins in my garage. When I was done, I thought now if in six months I need to look for something, just scan the bar code. Opened the app and weirdly it asked for a log in. I logged and nothing was there. Nothing recorded. I was beyond cheesed off. Of course, contacting these people was useless. Don’t bother with this one. I lost so much time I’ll never get back.

title: Fabulous concept, functionally useless
text: I regret buying labels and downloading the app. There’s an option in the app to upload images from my cellphone camera roll, but it doesn’t work. Every time I try I get an error message. If I take the photos from within the app, they don’t save to my camera roll—they only exist on the Elephant Trax service, which is very worrying from a privacy and sustainability perspective.

title: Huge lack of customer service
text: This is a great idea and could potentially be something really useful. Initially, I raved about Elephant Trax. However, after a recent app update, I lost everything in my app and can no longer browse the contents of boxes. When I scan stickers, I receive an error message. I’ve contacted customer service twice, once with no response and one asking me to confirm my email, which I did. No further response. Thanks to the lack of customer service, I’ve had to replace items that I needed right away due to not being able to stay in the attic long enough to go through every single box needed to find what I’m looking for. Completely defeats the purpose of the stickers. Will no longer recommend and now regretting I used them so much.

title: It has potential!
text: It’s a great way to stay organized at a very basic and easy level. It’s quick to scan and recognize the QR, and app doesn’t appear to glitch or shut down. But, there are some things that could use improvement. For example being able to modify a previously scanned QR. You are able to change the keywords and title of the box but not add pictures (to show the modifications). You’re limited to 10 pictures per QR code which can be limiting for a large box.  The app doesn’t remain logged in so, you have to be consistently logging in and for some reason, iPhone also doesn’t save the login & password chain.

title: Time out is a real pain
text: Works fine except that the app times and and wants you to login. Problem is that iPhone is not remembering the account and password so you have to remember on your own. Why?!!! Every other iPhone app remembers for you

title: DO NOT USE
text: Labeled all of my boxes and put them in storage. Created an account and signed in like it asked to do and 3 months later it says there is no record of me signing up for it. It won’t let me log in to scan my boxes. Now I have to go through everything and find out what each box contains. Would highly recommend going with something else. DO NOT USE!!!!

title: Good If It Works
text: I packed a few boxes as part of household organization project. Everything worked fine. I left it for a few weeks and now the app doesn’t work at all. I take the photos, add the keywords, scan QR code and get a message saying that the items were successfully assigned to a box. Then, when I go to move to the next set of items, I am shown the items that I just saved and asked if I want to scan the QR  code. This leads to an endless loop of scanning the QR code, getting the “success”message, and then  being asked if I want to scan the QR code. If I click on “cancel” when asked if I want to scan, the items go into the Unassigned tab. No response from customer service to my request for assistance. The concept is great, but this app doesn’t work.

title: Great concept but horribly flawed.
text: Seemed to work great initially but now it takes FOREVER to get logged in and now when I log in it says I have no labels stored. I spent a lot of time organizing and storing info and now it appears to all be gone.

title: Bug bug
text:
Terrible interface and bugs. 
Due to some bugs, you might loose your key words attached to photos, which is annoying and wasteful in time.

title: Wish I read the reviews before purchasing….
text: The app is glitchy and hard to use. Have to redo the of taking pictures, assigning QR codes and keywords get blown away whenever you have to redo the process. Was excited when I purchased it think I’ll go back to paper labels.

title: Privacy info not available
text: The link to privacy info that is there when you are agreeing to terms and conditions leads to a Not Found webpage. Since they can’t even manage to keep their privacy info up-to-date, I don’t trust them with my data so I deleted the app and will be returning the stickers.

title: Better to use a notebook and your own labels, but not a scam
text:
Update: the app is worse than originally experienced after using it. The photos refuse to be saved to a QR code on the sticker almost every single time. The app is impossible to use. I moved from a 2 star down to a 1 star.

It’s not intuitive, even for someone who grew up with and uses technology everyday. The tutorial doesn’t help beyond the first few steps, it took me multiple tries to attach a QR code to items in a box, and the layout is counter intuitive. You have to log in every time you open the app after closing it, it’s VERY annoying. If you’re listening to anything (music, podcast, etc) the app forces it to stop just to take a photo. It does what it says it can, just in the worst way possible. It’s like they took a great idea and put in less than a quarter the effort to make it decently usable.

title: Still logging me out
text: The app is still having lots of issues. Keeps logging me out. When I scan a QR Code to see what is in my box, it won’t pull up the list. I have to force close the app and then it makes me log back in again. Also, why does it have to take over my audio?  I’m listening to music as I pack and every time I take a photo or anything of the sort it stops my music and I have to go back and start my music. It’s annoying.

title: Don’t Buy!!!
text:
The camera function barely works and I have to take 500 hundred pics just to see what’s on one box. 

If possible I have all equipment and I would like a return.

title: Very limited
text: Doesn’t have great functionality. Pretty buggy. More effort than it’s worth. Doesn’t beat the sharpie yet.

title: Not intuitive
text:
This could be a great app and a great system, but there are limitations that make it time-consuming and inefficient. For example, the repetitive scanning and “assigning“ of QR codes. There is a pop-up that says that the QR code is assigned, and then once you back out of the menus, it prompts you to scan it again and again.
Additionally, I believe there is a tone assigned when you scan. I’m listening to a podcast and each time I try to scan a QR code, the podcast stops. This is unnecessary and irritating.

title: Did you actually test this app?
text: This app is so frustrating. Today it is not saving the barcode when I scan it for a new box. I am having to scan it over and over sgain. It says that it is saved, but when I close the window and try to say Done for the box, it asks me if I want to assign a QR code. It did not do this before, even just a few days ago. Also, it would be nice to have a search by box name. Please fix this app. Just sold my house and only have a few more days to get packed up. I’m wasting too much time trying to get things to save.

title: So far so good
text: My only issues as of right now is the constant having to log in and that when I assign an item to a label, it stays in the camera and I have to click out of each screen. Sometimes it won’t have assigned the item to the label and others it will have.

title: QR capture inconsistent
text: I’ve had to retake the code up to 3x occasionally. There will be misleading message that the save was successful but you’ll find the photos not assigned so you’ll need to repeat the process. Really slows down packing.

title: Terrible app, great concept
text: I really wanted to love this but I’m so sick of the app crashing!! It crashes every time I search something. It’s slow and crashes when adding stuff to the app. And it makes me assign the QR code like 3 times before it actually saves. And it doesn’t let me search my title of the box. It’s very clunky. I’ve been trying it for a while hoping it improves, but its time to move on.

title: App keeps closing
text: Every time I try to search something the app closes.

title: Very buggy app. Crashes every time I open it
text: We liked this app and QR codes at first. Spent probably 30-40 hours entering photos and keywords between my wife and I, and spent $50 on labels, etc.. Then my wife started experiencing app crashes and lost entries, so she gave up. I hung with it, but now, after we’ve moved, every time I search, I get one search and the app crashes…EVERY TIME. Feels like a poorly supported app that was just published in order to trick people into buying labels and QR codes. Don’t fall for it. Try something, ANYTHING else

title: great concept; needs work
text: app crashes each time i try adding items. frustrating. for those i was able to load, i wish it would let me edit the title. some aspects that f an entry can but edited but can’t rename if you change your mind.

title: Great concept, glitchy app
text: This could be great, but it needs some work! I use it but the app never remembers me, it always glitches and is slow, and the pack/find feature isn’t as intuitive as I would like. I hope the developers keep working on it though as I would really love to love this!

title: Great concept poor execution
text: This takes twice as long to do everything because the app constantly crashes. As in it works 2 out of every 5 times so far. I try to upload only 4 photos at a time and still have issues. Wish the camera would stay open and I didn’t have to select “capture new” every time.

title: Photos will delete
text: Spent hours getting everything just right with their finicky app only for nearly all the photos to end up deleted before we even got done with our one week move. Waste of time and money.

title: IT’S OK
text: Keeps shutting down and support could be better.

title: Good Concet
text:
It’s really to bad I love the idea behind this, but the app is sooooooooooooo slow responding and opening. Also saving seems to have an issue I’ve had to redo the same box with 3 QR code’s :-/ 

Kinda a waste of money.

title: Be warned…your pictures will disappear!!
text: I really loved this system at first and could not stop raving about how life changing it was. Spent hours getting my house organized and catalogued with the stickers. The app would crash every few minutes and you had to log in each time - annoying but I still enjoyed getting organized so I didn’t let that stop me from using it. Fast forward to 6 months later and a bunch of my pictures disappeared!!! It displays “photo not available” where the photo should be. It seems to be random pictures and in no particular order. I contacted support and waited days for them to come back and tell me the photos are just gone and I’ll have to retake them. So I have to unpack everything to figure out what’s missing? I don’t think so. To have all that time and effort wasted is such a shame :(

title: Great Concept
text: I really like the concept of being able to scan a label and see what I have stored inside my containers. The only problem I have is the process of having to take the pictures within the app and going back and forth within app to take pictures of items. I would prefer being able to take all my pictures with my phones camera app and then selecting pictures within the app. This way I can take pictures much faster. The other problem I have when having to take pictures within the app is that I’m having to click done so every so often so they save in case the app crashes it doesn’t delete all my photos and having to retake my photos again. The last issue I have encountered is having to login to my account each time. If the app crashes, which it does frequently, I have sign in again. Would really like if they added the Face ID feature. I really like the concept of this app but feel  it could use a few upgrades.

title: Can’t upload photos after the fact
text: As we were packing we took photos of everything on our phones as we were in different rooms, but when I sat down to upload and assign them to a box and label we realized you can only use photos taken directly through the app. So now that everything is packed away, I have no way to actually use the labels, since you cannot upload photos from your phone gallery. Very disappointed in the execution, but loved the concept as I am traveling for work and basically living out of a storage unit between assignments. Very bummed.

title: Incredible Idea, HORRIBLE Execution
text: I wanted to love this app so much. The sticker and app combo idea is incredible but whoever actually designed the app did a HORRIBLE job. The amount of technical errors and small annoyances that occur when using this app is INSANE and almost makes it not even worth using. As of right now, I cannot even properly log into the app because it consistently shuts down in the middle of the log in process, or it shows an error message when logging in. I think if they worked harder on the software, they could make this app great. Until then, it’s a bust.

title: Love the idea poor execution
text: The idea is great and affordable! I’m a huge organizer. However the app crashes just about every time you complete one action such as searching for one item then crash and log back in. Then search another item then crash and have to log back in.

title: Well...
text: I was impressed with the concept...my first box worked great! Onto my second box and not so great....this app needs a major revamp. Constantly having to login plus i go to scan my box to see what’s in it and nothing happens. I would recommend it to more if it actually worked.

title: Hours of lost work
text: I took pictures of everything, I gave everything QR codes, and when I log back on to see everything it all disappeared and had to start all over. Garbage.

title: No way to get Labels
text: Amazon has no labels and they don’t know if they will be restocked.
